timezone.description: The timezone for the scheduled report (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'UTC').

weekdays.description: List of weekdays when the scheduled report is generated (e.g., 'Monday', 'Tuesday'). Only applicable for weekly schedules.

schedule.description: The schedule configuration for the report. Only present when is_scheduled is true.

reports.description: A computed list of reports. Each object in the list contains detailed information about a report.

block.description: Retrieves Armis report information. Supports filtering by report_id or report_name. If report_id is provided, it takes precedence and fetches a single report directly from the API. If only report_name is provided, all reports are fetched and filtered client-side by name (case-sensitive exact match). If no filter is provided, all reports are returned.
